u0: No client order is pending and the agent is not carrying food. Idle between clients: watch the counter for a client arrival (client_arrived moves to u1), and handle any siren separately. No food should be held at this point.
u1: A client is waiting at the counter and has not yet given an order. Next objective: walk to the counter, face the client, and toggle to take the order (order_taken moves to u2). Keep an eye on the siren while crossing the room.
u2: The client's order is taken but the agent is empty-handed. Next objective: go to the pantry, face it, and pick up a portion of food (holding_food moves to u3). A planned slip will occur 2-7 steps after the pickup, so watch for food_fell.
u3: The agent holds raw (yellow) food and an order is waiting. Next objective: walk to the stove, face it, and toggle to prepare the food (food_prepared moves to u4 and scores +0.2). If the food slips first (food_fell moves to u6), it must be retrieved on the next move.
u4: The agent holds prepared (green) food and the client's order is still unserved. Next objective: return to the counter, face the client, and toggle to serve (order_served returns to u0 and scores +1). If the food slips (food_fell moves to u7), recover it immediately.
u5: Inactive fallback state with no outgoing transitions; the agent remains here. Note: this state is not reachable through any of the listed transitions, so no order, food, or siren objective applies.
u6: The raw food slipped out of the agent's hands while holding it after the order was taken; the agent is now empty-handed with the portion lying nearby (the agent faces it). Next objective: pick up the food on the very next move (holding_food moves back to u3 and scores +0.05). Do not detour.
u7: The prepared food slipped out of the agent's hands after preparation with the order still waiting; the agent is empty-handed and faces the fallen portion. Next objective: pick it up on the very next move (holding_food returns to u4 and scores +0.05), then deliver it to the client.
